theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cone_monotonicity_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → ∀ (z : Euclid P) (σ ρ : ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → R.measure (closedBall z σ) / ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n) + ∫⁻ x in closedBall z ρ \ closedBall z σ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - z) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - z‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure = R.measure (closedBall z ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
